findings.title: Scoped decorators return [] for out-of-scope per-trade list reads; placeBondsForAgreedTrade never calls loadTrade, so getHolds -> [] means no prior holds and it calls payments.placeHold with real cus_/pm_ ids. markDisputeReturnOverdue writes with no read. The domain guarantee is false and scopedRepositoryMoney.test fails as specified
findings.fix: Decorators refuse instead of returning empty: every tradeId-keyed method (reads and writes) checks tradeIsTest and throws OutOfScopeError. Entry points without loadTrade catch it and return their not-found failure. Name flagManualReconciliation, markHoldVoided and recordReturnOverdue in the table. The test counts only writes that returned

findings.title: Sandbox gate reads cookies only, so a Bearer request with no cookie is NONE -> ALLOW while the action runs as that user. Route handlers bypass the gate: /api/mobile/account/close calls the closure orchestrator directly, bypassing the frozen closeMyAccount
findings.fix: sessionState: bearer or session cookie present -> VALID if a user resolves, else UNRESOLVED; NONE only when neither. authenticateMobileRequest returns 404 when isSandboxMode(). Correct the 'mobile is covered' claim and add a Bearer test case

findings.title: The row-7 throw for a non-tester or UNRESOLVED session fires in the root layout (SiteHeader -> listMyNotifications) and lands on global-error, removing the switcher, Sign out and /sign-in. There is no in-app recovery
findings.fix: In sandbox mode, proxy.ts (already reading the profile) selects is_tester/is_admin/is_support and, for UNRESOLVED or valid non-tester non-staff sessions, expires sb-<ref>-auth-token* cookies locally (no GoTrue call) and redirects to /sign-in?sandbox=refused. The gate throw stays as a backstop; the pure decision function gets a unit test

findings.title: Staff admitted in the sandbox can moderate real production content: admin.hideItem, unhideItem, clearMemberAvatar, setReportStatus, setFeedbackStatus and resolveErrorGroup are unscoped
findings.fix: Add those six actions to SANDBOX_REAL_SIDE_EFFECT_ACTIONS with a moderation-specific message; state that the console's reports/feedback/errors tabs are read-only production data in the sandbox

findings.title: The four *_for bodies must equal the live cron function bodies, but the implementer has no SQL access (MCP unavailable) and nothing proves a copied migration-file body matches production
findings.fix: Copy from the newest defining migrations (0038, 0093, 0109, 0039) and open 0134 with a DO block comparing md5(prosrc) from pg_proc to each body's md5, raising LIVE_BODY_DRIFT. On drift the user reads prosrc read-only and the body is rebuilt. Pin the guards in testerMigration.test

findings.title: Making joys_joys and piggybear test-only on noditto.app (no real buying, selling, trading or listing; public listings removed) is effectively irreversible but recorded only as Open question 1, not a blocking precondition
findings.fix: Promote to P4 blocking 0134, with the recommended answer and the alternative of fresh user-created tester accounts whose ids replace the hardcoded ones

findings.title: Known contract-table readers absent from the checklist carry policy decisions left to the implementer: getCounterpartyIdentity (legal-name disclosure), disputeEvidence.*, demo.fire*Webhook, contractStepPlan, account-closure Money_In_Flight, regionBinding, notification link checks, messageAttachments, offer counts
findings.fix: Add the decision table from the review (filter / rowInScope refusal / reasoned exemption per reader) to section 4.4 and the Checklist, so the static test's first run confirms decisions instead of making them

findings.title: Domain factories are told to call currentScope(), which lives in lib/ and breaks layering
findings.fix: Use testRowScope(resolveSandboxMode(process.env)) from domain/sandbox in the factories

findings.title: The switcher's early 'return null' before its hooks violates react-hooks/rules-of-hooks
findings.fix: Make the exported component a guard rendering an inner component that holds the hooks

findings.title: The overview claims a production server only touches real rows, but offer decline/withdraw, sendMessage, own-listing edit/delete and invite revoke still write test rows from production
findings.fix: Restate it as no creation, money, holds, jobs or arbitration on test rows in production, with participant edits harmless; or scope those paths

findings.title: The static money-primitive rule omits lib/actions/tradeFees.ts (chargeTradeFees, refundTradeFees)
findings.fix: Extend the every-export-calls-rowInScope rule to tradeFees.ts and add refundTradeFees to the chokepoint table

findings.title: P2 recommends frank/grace as sandbox staff although plan.md flagged their committed production passwords
findings.fix: Recommend a user-controlled staff account, or make password rotation part of P2

findings.title: Sandbox card setup leaves a mock payment_source_id on joys_joys's real profile
findings.fix: Record it under Risks with the un-flag cleanup

findings.title: testerMigration.test pins only two literals, not every identityGate regex anchor
findings.fix: Assert 0134 contains none of 'as is_verified', 'into new.seller_identity_verified', /verified\s*:=/ or 'profiles_sync_items_seller_identity_verified'
